policies.title: Ecuadorian ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Grenada's live Embassy-linked schedule lists Ecuador as not requiring a visitor visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Ecuadorian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule is marked updated April 2024; recheck if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Ecuadorian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table states that Ecuadorian visitors can obtain a 40-JOD visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Ecuadorian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
All non-Jordanians must register for a Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure.
Entry-point, admission and non-visitor categories remain governed by Jordanian authorities.

policies.title: Ecuadorian ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy visitor schedule names Ecuador in its no-visa-required cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Ecuadorian passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to three months.
Passport validity, funds, onward travel and final admission remain governed by Panama's authorities.
